shared_or_similar_visual_information: The numerical notation 10 in both images.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The exterior secant segment has length value 10. Right image: The numeral 10 identifies the adjacent angle region; it is an angle index, not a degree measure.
Rationales: The selected 10 is a segment-length value on a secant; the other 10 names an angle region at a line crossing.
